name: Buttplug.io (Intiface)
summary: Essential open-source haptics middleware (Intiface Central) unifying Lovense, Kiiroo, The Handy, OSR2, and We-Vibe into games & VR players.
ranking_rationale: Breaks brand lock-in by connecting nearly every Bluetooth/Wi-Fi toy to HereSphere, DeoVR & games; weighed against initial windows bluetooth dongle pairing occasionally takes tinkering.

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Breaks brand lock-in by connecting nearly every Bluetooth/Wi-Fi toy to HereSphere, DeoVR & games
Zero cloud spying—runs completely over local Bluetooth & WebSockets
cons: Initial Windows Bluetooth dongle pairing occasionally takes tinkering
Utility layer only (paired with players/games for media)
